evidence.name: Screen field: What the button does
evidence.userNeed: Know what "What the button does" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: What the button does
sections.description: Chooses the pinned button's job: a standard button navigates to the next screen (use it on flow steps like 'Continue'), while a purchase button starts checkout and ties into your paywall products (use it on the paywall). The bar holds one button at a time, so switching type replaces it with a fresh default — your bar styling is kept, but you'll need to re-set the button's label and action.
